interface.shortDescription: Tenders, AI CPV finder and one free email alert.
interface.longDescription: Search public tenders across Europe and North America, compare deadlines and budgets, and build a shortlist. Sign in to Scoutee for free: its AI combines your company's activity with its knowledge base to find your EU CPV codes. Use reviewed codes with workspace search, or browse and download the official CPV catalogue. Register free to enable one daily email alert on Scoutee, with up to 20 results per search.
defaultPrompt: Help me find the CPV codes for my business with Scoutee.
